Hi Vivek,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement here — attaching the draft Order Form our team redlined. Two callouts we need clarity on before I can route to ops for PO processing:

- Net terms: Our standard is net45, but the order form currently shows net30. Can Redwood accept net45 for this commercial?
- Invoice cadence & entity: We want monthly invoices to our US entity (Ambience Labs, Inc.). Need confirmation the invoice recipient can be set per the attached payment-schedule.
- Tax delegation: we have a local VAT registration in the EU and may request reverse-charge evidence; for now confirm Redwood will not withhold VAT from US invoices.

I've attached Ambience_OrderForm_v2-redlines.pdf and a high-level payment-schedule.xlsx. Can you loop in legal and sales ops? Procurement wants to close this week.

Thanks,

Ambience Labs

Hi Sarah — thanks for sending this over and for the clear summary. Looping in Kimberly (legal) and Aditya (sales ops) to confirm the items below. Quick responses inline: 

- Net terms: we can typically offer net45 for enterprise deals with approved credit; need finance sign-off (Kimberly, is this okay to propose in the commercial appendix?).
- Invoice cadence & entity: we can route invoices to Ambience Labs, Inc. per your schedule. We just need the PO and remit-to details on file.
- Tax delegation: we do not proactively withhold VAT on US invoices — we will follow the invoice-level tax treatment provided by your team and support reverse-charge evidence where applicable.

Kimberly / Aditya — can you review the attached redlines and confirm two asks: 1) confirm net45 acceptance (and any SLA/credit preconditions), 2) accept the suggested "invoice recipient/ remit-to" field in the payment-schedule. If we can confirm by EOD Wed the procurement team can route a PO Thurs.

Thanks — I can set up a 30m sync if it helps.

Thanks Vivek — reviewed the PDF redlines (Ambience_OrderForm_v2-redlines.pdf). Summary of legal stance and proposed editable language below. I kept it tight so procurement can push to ops.

1) Net terms
- We are comfortable with Net 45 for this order provided: (a) customer signs the amended Commercial Appendix, and (b) finance completes credit check (standard for commitments > $100k).
- Proposed clause (one sentence to add to Payment Terms): "Invoices will be due forty-five (45) days from invoice date, subject to final credit approval."

2) Invoice cadence & remit-to entity
- Acceptable to route invoices monthly to Ambience Labs, Inc. Please ensure PO contains the remit-to address and tax ID.
- Proposed addition to Order Form: a mandatory "Invoice Recipient" field in the Order Form header.

3) Tax / VAT handling
- Redwood will invoice gross for US-sourced services. For EU VAT reverse-charge requests, we will accept valid customer VAT registration evidence and annotate the invoice accordingly; we will not voluntarily withhold VAT from amounts invoiced to US entity.

4) Attachments & signature flow
- Legal agrees we can accept the customer's redlines except for two minor edits (section on termination for convenience and the indemnity cross-reference). I flagged those in the attached PDF. If procurement is pushing, we can accept the redlines conditionally and capture carveouts in the Appendix.

Next steps I recommend: Vivek/Aditya propose the two-line Net45 change and the Invoice Recipient field. Aditya — please update commercial appendix and resend a clean Order Form (PDF + editable) to Sarah + procurement. If finance needs additional evidence, we'll ask Ambience for their latest credit form.

— Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Contracts & Privacy
Redwood Inference
